name: Kodak Ektar 100
source: Kodak Alaris, KODAK PROFESSIONAL EKTAR 100 Film, publication E-4046 (February 2016)

notes.characteristic: Daylight exposure, Status M densitometry, Log H Ref -0.84.
notes.sensitivity: Daylight, effective exposure 1/25 s, Status M, density 0.2 above D-min, sensitivity = 1/exposure (erg/cm2).
notes.dye_density: Diffuse spectral density, typical densities for a midscale neutral subject and D-min (no per-dye curves published).

grain.note: Print Grain Index (not rms granularity): diffuse-printing illumination, 14 in viewing distance; 25 is the visual threshold, 4 units one just-noticeable difference. Magnifications as printed (the 4x5 row reads 1.2X, 4X, 8X).
